check_service_status.description: Check whether yesno.wtf is answering, and how quickly. This is the one action that reports a problem as a value instead of failing the step, so a workflow can decide what to do about it. Being throttled is reported separately from being down.
check_service_status.name: check_service_status

get_answer.description: Ask yesno.wtf for a random yes or no, with a reaction GIF to go with it. Each run draws again. About once in 10,000 asks the service says maybe instead; turn off 'Allow maybe' to ask again when it does, so the answer is always yes or no.
get_answer.display_name: Get a yes or no answer
get_answer.display_str_template: Get a yes or no answer.
get_answer.name: get_answer

parameters.description: Keep the service's rare 'maybe'. On by default. Turn it off when a later step only handles yes and no, and a maybe is asked again instead.
parameters.name: allow_maybe

answer.description: 'yes', 'no' or, about once in 10,000 random asks, 'maybe'. Always lowercase.

forced.description: Whether the answer was chosen by the step rather than drawn at random.

image.description: The address of a reaction GIF for the answer, hosted on yesno.wtf. Chat apps show it as the animation when it is posted.

is_yes.description: True only when the answer is 'yes'. Added by Lodol so a step can branch on it directly; false for 'maybe' as well as for 'no'.

get_answer_gif.description: Get a reaction GIF for an answer you choose: yes, no or maybe. Use it when a workflow has already decided, such as an approval that went through, and wants a GIF to post with the result. A different GIF can come back on each run.
get_answer_gif.display_name: Get a GIF for an answer
get_answer_gif.display_str_template: Get a GIF for the answer {0}.
get_answer_gif.name: get_answer_gif

parameters.description: The answer to get a GIF for.
parameters.name: answer

answer.description: 'yes', 'no' or, about once in 10,000 random asks, 'maybe'. Always lowercase.

forced.description: Whether the answer was chosen by the step rather than drawn at random.

image.description: The address of a reaction GIF for the answer, hosted on yesno.wtf. Chat apps show it as the animation when it is posted.

is_yes.description: True only when the answer is 'yes'. Added by Lodol so a step can branch on it directly; false for 'maybe' as well as for 'no'.

description: Settle a question with yesno.wtf, the free yes-or-no API. Draw a random yes or no to decide for a workflow, or pick the answer yourself and get a reaction GIF to post with it. Every answer comes with a GIF address that chat apps show as the animation, and with a plain true or false to branch on.
